title: Asymptotic expansion of induced Grassmannian Chern forms and distribution of random degeneracy sets
summary: For the Grassmannian embeddings defined by the spaces $H^0(X,L^p\otimes E)$, where $L$ is a positive line bundle and $E$ is a holomorphic vector bundle over a compact complex manifold, we prove a complete asymptotic expansion of the induced Grassmannian Chern forms and compute the first coefficients explicitly.
